en.html:
...A contemptible weapon like that!

I need only meet it with all my strength and prevent the edge from reaching me—
en.text:
...A contemptible weapon like that!

I need only meet it with all my strength and prevent the edge from reaching me—

ja.html:
……そのような卑劣な武器など！
　満身の力をもって受け止め、刃先を届かせねば良い
だけの事――
ja.text:
……そのような卑劣な武器など！
　満身の力をもって受け止め、刃先を届かせねば良い
だけの事――

en.html: Damn it! My fingers were convulsing—◆there was no strength, none at all————!
en.text:
Damn it!

My fingers were convulsing—◆there was no strength, none at all————!

ja.html: しまった！ 　指が痙攣して――◆力が、全く――――！
ja.text:
しまった！
　指が痙攣して――◆力が、全く――――！

en.html:
